newsitem.title: THAILAND: TRIS downgrades battered Thai banks, finance firms.
newsitem.headline: TRIS downgrades battered Thai banks, finance firms.

text.p: Thai Rating and Information Services (TRIS) on Friday announced sweeping debt rating downgrades of nine leading Thai banks and finance firms which it said would likely face increased non-performing loans.

The Thai rating agency also said it had withdrawn ratings of another five finance and brokerage firms at the request of the companies facing the same problem arising from Thailand's sharp economic downturn and tougher business climate.
"Escalation of non-performing loans to a significantly higher level is expected as loan books that were vigorously expanded in the past mature through the economic cycle," it said in a statement.

TRIS, painting a gloomy projection, said it saw all Thai financial institutions facing much tougher medium-term operating outlooks and, despite their increased emphasis on asset quality, the firms were susceptible to further economic decline.

Debenture ratings downgraded by TRIS were those of Bangkok Bank Plc, Thai Farmers Bank Plc, Siam City Bank Plc, Industrial Finance Corp of Thailand, Phatra Thanakit Plc, Cathay Finance and Securities Plc, Ekachart Finance and Securities Plc, Kiatnakin Finance and Securities Plc, and Thai Thamrong Finance Co Ltd.
It said companies requesting rating cancellation were Dhana Siam Finance and Securities Plc, Asia Securities Trading Plc, General Finance and Securities Plc, Finance One Plc, and Securities One Plc.

TRIS said although most non-performing loans of financial institutions were backed with sufficient provisions, steadily declining collateral value and prolonged problem loans would produce increased doubtful debts.

"Deteriorated asset quality and additional reserves required for substandard loans will result in large provisioning burdens...subdued economic expansion and dismal securities activities are expected to further strain profitability of Thai financial institutions."
TRIS announced the following debt downgrades:
